summary: The plan matches the request and the accepted reading. I read the snapshot to check what it names. The target sentence is at crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md:5 ("The fmt, clippy and test results under \"Checks Athena ran on this tree\" ... Cite them; ..."). No test asserts its wording; the only references are include_str! calls in athena-cap-change, athena-context and athena-cap-study. CHANGELOG.md has '## [Unreleased]' at line 8 and '### Changed' at line 10, which is where the plan files the entry. crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs has every_role_set_is_within_its_budget, which composes the change verifier set and calls check_budget(BudgetSet::Verifier, ...). The demonstration for criterion 4 is therefore real: an overrun fails it. The edit sits where the fault starts, in the instruction that says 'cite them' without saying where. The scope is one sentence plus one changelog bullet, which fits one producer run. I found only small wording points, none blocking.
